description: This file defines a custom error type and a utility function to wait asynchronously until a specific condition is met with a timeout.

classes.name: AsyncWaitTimeoutError
classes.description: A custom error used to signal timeout while waiting for an asynchronous condition.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until a provided condition returns true or until the timeout expires, throwing an error on timeout.
